bihar_raw_news.title: Parliamentary Affairs
bihar_raw_news.content: In the parliamentary democratic system, the role of the legislature is important. The legislature determines the direction of the state's work and motivates the executive to perform well according to welfare. Through various legislative works, such as legislation, budget placement, debate on issues of public importance, question, assurance, attention, etc., motivates the administration to work in accordance with the assumptions of democracy. The Parliamentary Affairs Department has an important role in the operation of all the above legislative works. Considering these requirements and expectations, the Department of Parliamentary Affairs was formed in the year 1972. According to the Executive Manual, the following functions have been allotted to this department: - Preparation of the Governor's address for the joint session of the Legislative Assembly. Calling and Session of Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council sessions. Preparation of programs for the sessions of both the Houses of the State Legislature. Organizing and coordinating legislative and other government functions in Legislative Assembly and Legislative Council Formation and implementation of the Informal Consultative Committees of the members of the Legislative Assembly related to various departments. Monitoring of the questions, requests, attention of the legislation proposals and responses to the workplace proposals, implementation of assurances by the departments, and coordination for this work among the various departments. Coordination of action taken by various departments on the recommendations made by the Legislative Committee's committees. Counsel in matters related to the powers, privileges and responsibilities of members of the Legislative Assembly and Parliamentary system and work. All the work related to the salary, allowance and other remuneration of the Legislative Assembly, Presiding Officers and Deputy Presiding Officers. Contacting leaders and alumni of various parties. Various representations on the panel of Legislative Assembly and the Legislative Council are kept by the departments. Allocation of government time for debate in the House on proposals communicated by non-official members. To agree on nomination of members of the Legislature for committees and bodies constituted by the government.

national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 2:03 PM Har Ghar Tiranga campaign begins with multiple events across country to celebrate patriotism and national unity The Har Ghar Tiranga campaign is being celebrated nationwide to foster a sense of patriotism among citizens, strengthen national unity, and promote India’s cultural heritage. The campaign marks the fifth year of the Har Ghar Tiranga initiative, which began in 2022 and has since evolved into one of the country’s largest public participation movements. The initiative is aimed at encouraging citizens to hoist the National Flag and participate in activities celebrating patriotism, national unity and India’s cultural heritage. This year’s campaign holds special significance as it coincides with the 150th anniversary of India’s National Song, “Vande Mataram,” bringing together the National Flag and the National Song in a unique celebration of patriotism. As part of the celebrations, mass singing of Vande Mataram will be organised across the country. In Delhi, as part of the campaign, Lok Sabha BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj paid floral tribute at the memorial of Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya in Malviya Nagar followed by a Tiranga Yatra from Pilanji Village to Greater Kailash. Speaking to the media, Ms Swaraj said that this Independence Day is particularly special as India marks its 80th. She added that the BJP has launched a week-long campaign starting today, during which party office-bearers and workers will visit the memorials of national heroes and martyrs. national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 1:50 PM NIA arrests one more accused in connection with seizure of huge consignment of illegal explosives in Malappuram, Keralam The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested another accused in connection with the seizure of a huge consignment of illegal explosives in Malappuram, Keralam. The Agency informed that the accused was arrested yesterday from Manjeri in the Malappuram district. NIA said that the accused is a main conspirator and was involved in the illegal procurement of the explosives seized in the case. The latest arrest comes a day after the NIA arrested three more accused from Vijayapura in Karnataka on Friday, taking the total number of arrests in the case to ten. national_raw_news.title: Vice President hoists National Flag in Andaman and Nicobar Islands as part of ‘Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign’
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 2:19 PM Vice President hoists National Flag in Andaman and Nicobar Islands as part of ‘Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign’ Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan today hoisted the National Flag at the Flag Point in Sri Vijaya Puram, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, as part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign’. On the occasion, he paid tribute to the brave freedom fighters. The Vice President also attended the state function, ‘Tiranga Concert on Vande Mataram’, held at the auditorium of Dr B. R. Ambedkar Institute of Technology. In his address, the Vice President recalled the glorious history of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands associated with India’s freedom struggle. He said this is the very land where freedom fighters endured severe torture and unimaginable hardships for the country’s independence. Referring to the historical significance of the Cellular Jail, Mr Radhakrishnan paid homage to the sacrifices and contributions of the freedom fighters. He also recalled the historic day of 30th December 1943, when Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose hoisted the Tricolour in Port Blair. The Vice President said that whenever the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are mentioned, one not only thinks of their natural beauty and lush greenery but also remembers the spirit of patriotism associated with Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose hoisting the Tricolour here for the first time. Referring to the significance of ‘Vande Mataram’, the Vice President said that the song played an important role in strengthening the spirit of nationalism and unity among the people during the freedom movement. He described the Andaman and Nicobar Islands as a symbol of India’s diversity and unity. He also emphasised the need to maintain a balance between the country’s development and environmental protection. Mr Radhakrishnan is on a two-day visit to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Yesterday, he visited the National Memorial Cellular Jail and paid tribute to the brave freedom fighters. He also visited Veer Savarkar’s cell and witnessed the light and sound show organised at the Cellular Jail. national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 7, 2026 9:35 PM GeM emerges as cornerstone of India’s digital governance ecosystem: CEO Mihir Kumar India’s national public procurement platform, Government e-Marketplace (GeM) has achieved a cumulative Gross Merchandise Value of over 20 lakh crore rupees in the last ten years.
